description: Router for any marketing ask with no playbook named: picks the one GooseWorks marketing playbook for the job and runs it. Use when the ask is vague ("help me with marketing", "where do I start") or is a job not covered yet (a one-off brand setup), which it says plainly; video ads and product photos go to the goose-video and goose-product-photos skills. Not for an ask that names a job, even two jobs ("plan our launch and make the ads"): pick the playbook for the first job. Not for a playbook already chosen: run that one directly.
